title: Steppenwolf Theatre

services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: Attend with a group and save! Group tickets are available for each Steppenwolf production once single tickets go on sale (usually 6-8 weeks before the first performance). Select six to ten tickets in your order and the groups discount will apply automatically in your cart. If you’re a school teacher, college professor or work with students in any capacity, send an email to groups@steppenwolf.org to learn more about our academic group rates. We’ll work out details and get your group ready to go. Let us know how we can help you plan for your next group outing. Staff are available for in-person service starting 1 hour before each
